question: Under what condition might the ascetic woman become desirous of the practitioner?
premises: The subject is an ascetic woman.
Her desire may arise in relation to the practitioner.
inference: The ascetic woman may become desirous of him because of his appearance.
uncertainties: The exact nuance of veṣataḥ in this context is somewhat ambiguous.
plain_english: And that ascetic woman may become desirous of him because of his appearance.
